environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate. The ALB has a default action of fixed-response 403. Traffic is permitted only via three ordered listener rules: Rule 1 (priority 10) matches source-ip condition against a prefix list containing 10.200.0.0/16 (internal VPN egress), 172.20.0.0/14 (partner network peered via Transit Gateway), and 192.168.50.0/24 (CI/CD runners). Rule 2 (priority 20) matches source-ip 10.100.0.0/16 with an additional path-pattern /api/v2/notifications/* and forwards to the target group. Rule 3 (priority 30) is a catch-all fixed-response 403. The ALB security group ingress is restricted to these same CIDR ranges on port 443. Additionally, the ECS task's security group only allows inbound from the ALB security group. AWS VPC Flow Logs are enabled with REJECT logging. The prefix list is managed via AWS RAM shared from the network account and requires an SCP-approved change request to modify.
